# March 31, 1950
max_1950 = 275000
outstanding_1950 = 255013
util_1950 = (outstanding_1950 / max_1950) * 100

# March 31, 1955
max_1955 = 281000
outstanding_1955 = 273571

# Arithmetic mean
mean_util = (util_1950 + util_1955) / 2

print(f'1950 Utilization Rate: {util_1950:.4f}%')
print(f'1955 Utilization Rate: {util_1955:.4f}%')
print(f'Mean Utilization Rate: {mean_util:.2f}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(mean_util, 2)}')
"
